english.title: Person charged with offence fail to furnish statement of financial circumstances
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been charged with an offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..), failed to furnish a statement of your financial circumstances in response to an official request
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20A(1A) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Time limit for prosecutions - either within two years of the commission of the offence or within six months of its discovery by the prosecutor whichever is earlier (sec . 20A(3)).
(ii) See also offence wordings H4401, H4402 and H4403.
(iii) This offence inserted into the CJA 1991 by section 95 Courts Act 2003.
